import React from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; function Navbar({ user, cart = [], onLogout }) { const cartCount = cart.reduce((count, item) => count + item.quantity, 0); return (
{/* Logo */} MyShop {/* Navigation Links */}
Products Cart ({cartCount}) {user ? ( <> Orders Hello, {user.name} ) : ( Login )}
); } export default Navbar;
